scope: Different-author fail-closed source hammer of M1826 TSBG production governance. CPython 3.6/3.10 static, AST, exact-identity, seal, and in-memory semantic probes only; no EDA, license query, release, attempt, result, predecessor modification, or docs359 modification.
verdict: FAIL-CLOSED. The concrete M1826 runner contains the intended strong forms, all predecessor identities and seals match, both interpreters pass the positive source checker, and all 73 declared mutations—including the twelve M1824 categories—are rejected. That does not establish the claimed governance non-bypassability. An independent fifteen-attack suite escaped 15/15 on both interpreters. The checker proves exact flock call arguments but not the paths and open calls that produced those handles; proves direct publication calls but not the renameat2 primitive body; proves resource and collision predicates but not their effective bodies or unforgeable inputs; proves expected identity construction but not that the comparison raises; and does not prove the authority/seal primitives, exact attempt path/mkdir arguments, or post-attempt quarantine operations. M1828 and VCS are not authorized.

findings.title: Critical governance path provenance and guard bodies remain semantically bypassable
findings.evidence: The independent suite changed queue/local lock path or handle origin while preserving exact flock arguments, enabled reusable ATTEMPT.mkdir or conditionally misbound ATTEMPT, short-circuited renameat2, neutralized collision/resource/failure bodies, returned early from exact or review-seal verification, and neutralized the release identity mismatch action. Every mutation passed validate_semantics on CPython 3.6 and 3.10.
findings.risk: A successor can retain every currently checked token, direct-call order, predicate, identity dictionary, and declared mutation target while making exclusive execution, one-shot consumption, authority, transitive seals, resource exclusion, failure quarantine, or no-replace publication ineffective. The source hammer therefore cannot authorize the sole no-retry VCS campaign.
findings.required_fix: Do not overwrite M1826. In an additive successor, AST-pin exact SHARED_QUEUE/LOCK/ATTEMPT/RESULT/FAILURE/PRIVATE path assignments, exact handle-origin open calls and modes, argument-free ATTEMPT.mkdir, and complete bodies of exact/seal/publish/collision/resource/release-guard/quarantine primitives. Require direct raises and data provenance, not only predicate presence. Add all fifteen M1827 attacks to the mutation suite and obtain a fresh different-author zero-P0/P1 hammer before any release or VCS.
